# Separate direct store discovery from its legacy-assisted test hierarchy

discoverChildFolders returns only immediate child names. The test then builds folder objects, but getChildNamed itself triggers legacy folder discovery; the test comments warn that tricky names can be disturbed. Active cases cover empty/basic nested names in both stores, while escaped-name cases stay commented out. The original filename helpers were conversion-only stubs for separate compilation; fixed helpers are later implementations. Do not treat this discovery test as proof that escaped/reserved names round-trip independently of legacy discovery. No filesystem or platform test ran.

Scope: Direct store discovery test boundary.
